status: source-faithful parsed field definitions; no identity normalization

rules.rawAndInterpreted: Exact source text and lexical values are retained beside interpretations; interpreted values remain null unless a source-specific rule and evidence authorize them.
rules.identity: Source record identifiers remain separate from canonical resource identifiers. Similar names never establish food, product, dish, or recipe identity.
rules.unknowns: Unavailable values stay null with explicit status. Do not infer translation, origin, dietary properties, nutrient equivalence, or portion weight.
rules.provenance: Every record binds source ID/release/citation, original SHA-256, extracted-text SHA-256, parser version, and source page/line/UTF-8 byte span where available.
rules.privacy: Parsed evidence remains local-private under retained source contracts and rights/custody holds.
